settings.name: Fäsenstaub with renovation redundancy
settings.notes: Alternative appraisal of the same investment, not an additional project. The matched no-project reference closes the old tube for the configured years; the project carries one lane per direction in the new tube. Other years use the ordinary reference and full design. Five years of full closure is a user-defined sensitivity, not ASTRA's announced safety-gallery construction programme. See docs/faesenstaub_redundancy.md.

settings.name: Amriswil six-access bypass with Hof feeder
settings.notes: 11.8 km costed mainline, 80 km/h, 1500 veh/h/direction, six accesses and approximately 519 m Hof feeder. Receiving-road capacity is retained. Edit physical attributes and 15-second access allowances in the GeoPackage; see docs/road_designs.md.

settings.name: A15 Uster–Hinwil deep-long tunnel concept
settings.notes: Screening representation of the deep-long variant between Uster-Ost and Betzholz (Hinwil), with two lanes per direction and no Wetzikon interchange. Alignment and junction geometry are modelling assumptions while ASTRA studies alternatives. Opening in 2040 is a scenario assumption. See docs/a15_uster_hinwil.md.

service_audit.service_extent: corridor endpoints only; no extra through service beyond them
service_audit.assumptions: Existing running/dwell times retained. Infrastructure paths, rolling stock, connections and operating costs not validated.

settings.name: Rafz–Schaffhausen 15-minute rail concept

pt_component_effects.notes: Illustrative station-access and interchange package. Access applies at the origin, egress at the destination, and transfer reductions only to trips with transfers and a corridor endpoint. Frequency already changes waiting: additional waiting reductions default to zero to avoid counting the same improvement twice. Set target_headway_min=None to test waiting reductions alone.

settings.notes: Hypothetical additional trains in both directions, confined to Rafz–Schaffhausen; actual segment running times are retained. No assumed 15-minute through-service to Zurich. Capacity, connections, rolling stock and operating costs require verification.
